about: Public police and traffic data Siren downloads automatically near each covered area. Add a place: copy an entry, open a pull request. 'history' feeds become hotspots (traffic stops or crashes); 'live' feeds show active calls on the map. Siren reads the newest copy of this file from GitHub (main branch) once a day.

feeds.name: New Orleans Police (NOPD)
feeds.where: ((typetext = 'TRAFFIC INCIDENT' AND selfinitiated = 'Y') OR typetext = 'DIRECTED TRAFFIC ENFORCEMENT')
feeds.source: City of New Orleans open data - NOPD calls for service

feeds.name: Dallas Police active calls
feeds.source: City of Dallas open data - Dallas Police Active Calls

feeds.name: Utah crash reports (UDOT)
feeds.updated: nightly by UDOT (reports take months to appear)
feeds.source: Utah Department of Transportation crash data
